note: Green since 2026-09-19. The former failure, test_candidate_search_prefers_deep_reuse_without_eviction, was caused by the optional materialization search's initial grant being pinned flat at 5 ms; a flat cap dominated whenever the incumbent was expensive, so the search verified too few targets and admission could fall back to one-step eviction or to the root incumbent and re-prefill the prompt (upstream issue #229). The grant now scales with the incumbent's cost up to a 250 ms ceiling, governed by the economic term and the boundary allowance (src/runtime/engine/context_cache/materialization_budget.h).
